orientations.intent: Determine whether the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system.

final_message: No — none of the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) provide the capability to publish a checklist to a remote release system. The orient check confirmed this capability is unavailable in the reachable world. These tools appear limited to local repository, test, git, and episode operations, with no remote-publishing functionality exposed.
